description: This file defines a static class RetryOperation with methods to produce delay durations and an internal RetryHelper class with a method for retrying asynchronous operations with exponential backoff and exception handling, used for testing retry logic.

classes.name: RetryOperation
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate delay durations for retries, such as sigmoid and linear delay curves.

classes.name: RetryHelper
classes.description: Contains a method to perform asynchronous retries of operations with delay strategies, including exception handling and cancellation support.

methods.name: Sigmoid
methods.description: Generates a sigmoid-shaped delay time based on the retry attempt number.

methods.name: LinearWithTenMilliseconds
methods.description: Returns a linear delay increasing by 10 milliseconds per retry attempt.

methods.name: RetryOnExceptionAsync
methods.description: Retries an asynchronous operation up to a maximum number of attempts, with configurable delay, handling exceptions and supporting cancellation.
